description:
A standard library needs more than rustdoc. Create the documentation that drives adoption.

Deliverables:
1. Getting Started guide (README expansion or mdBook)
2. Cookbook: common patterns (validate TLS cert, check CRL, load system trust store, custom crypto backend)
3. Migration guide from rustls-webpki
4. Migration guide from openssl-rs
5. Architecture overview with diagrams (the existing ASCII diagram is good but needs more)
6. Security considerations document (what PKIX does and does not protect against)

Acceptance: A Rust developer unfamiliar with PKIX can go from cargo add to working TLS cert validation in under 30 minutes by following the docs.
title: Documentation, examples, and migration guides
